title: SAVU-BENCH: A Real-World Benchmark for Spatial Audio-Visual Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.10624v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Spatial audio-visual understanding requires models to recognize not only what is present, but also where events occur and how they relate across modalities. Existing benchmarks often rely on simulated scenes, evaluate isolated spatial skills, and provide limited diagnostic insight into failure modes. We introduce SAVU-Bench, a real-world benchmark that systematically evaluates spatial audio-visual understanding across three capability levels and seven evaluation tasks. We further introduce SAVU-Diag, a scene-linked diagnostic set that decomposes reasoning questions into their prerequisite grounding and alignment sub-tasks. Evaluation of 12 representative models on SAVU-Bench reveals that while visual spatial grounding is relatively mature, spatial perception involving audio remains a primary bottleneck. translated_title: SAVU-BENCH：一个面向空间视听理解的真实世界基准
translated_abstract: 空间视听理解要求模型不仅能识别存在什么，还要识别事件发生在哪里以及它们跨模态之间的关联。现有基准通常依赖于模拟场景、评估孤立的空间技能，并且对失败模式提供的诊断洞察有限。我们提出了SAVU-Bench，这是一个真实世界基准，通过三个能力层级和七个评估任务系统地评估空间视听理解。我们进一步引入了SAVU-Diag，这是一个与场景相关联的诊断集，它将推理问题分解为其前提性的定位（grounding）和对齐（alignment）子任务。对12个代表性模型在SAVU-Bench上的评估表明，虽然视觉空间定位已相对成熟，但涉及音频的空间感知仍然是主要瓶颈。SAVU-Diag进一步表明，大多数推理错误与这些前提子任务的失败同时出现，尽管推理方面的差距仍在持续出现……（摘要原文不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出真实世界基准SAVU-Bench和诊断集SAVU-Diag，系统评估空间视听理解，发现涉及音频的空间感知是主要瓶颈，且大多数推理错误源于前提定位与对齐子任务的失败。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SAVU-Bench, a real-world benchmark, and SAVU-Diag, a scene-linked diagnostic set, for systematic evaluation of spatial audio-visual understanding, revealing that audio-involved spatial perception remains the primary bottleneck and most reasoning errors co-occur with failures in prerequisite grounding and alignment sub-tasks.
